subject: Passband concurrency plan and reproducibility checklist
messages:
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.example.com>
To: Sophie Lee <sophie@bluewave-retail.com>
Cc: Marcus Chen <marcus.chen@bluewave-retail.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.example.com>
Date: Sat, 15 May 2027 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Passband concurrency plan and reproducibility checklist

Hi Sophie / Marcus —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and the items we promised to follow up on: 

1) Latency targets: you said 95th <= 220ms for streaming inference with 1–2s average utterances.
2) Concurrency mix: 70% short (<=64 tokens), 25% medium (65–512), 5% long (>512).
3) Throughput desires: baseline sustained 1,200 reqs/min per service, burst to 2,500 for promotions.
4) Streaming specifics: we need requirements for partial-turn flushing and maximum allowed tail latency.

Next steps I recommend (we can iterate):
- BlueWave: confirm which endpoints will use streaming vs. non-streaming (approx %).
- Redwood: provide a harness template and a draft prompt set + measurement definitions.
- Joint: pick a 2-hour window next week for a reproducibility run.

Attached: bw-benchmark-harness-template.csv (simple columns for request ids, token distributions, timestamps). I also linked a Drive folder with an initial prompt-set draft (will drop v1 there once Marissa validates).

If the recaps above match your notes, please reply with any corrections and a preferred slot next week (we have Wed/Thu mornings PDT open).

Thanks,
Logan
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: bw-benchmark-harness-template.csv (CSV)]

From: Sophie Lee <sophie@bluewave-retail.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.example.com>
Cc: Marcus Chen <marcus.chen@bluewave-retail.com>
Date: Mon, 17 May 2027 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Passband concurrency plan and reproducibility checklist

Thanks, Logan — this matches our notes closely. A couple clarifications from our side: 

- Streaming adoption: estimated 40% streaming traffic (chat-like), 60% request/response.
- For streaming partial-turn flushing, we need a maximum tail latency of 350ms (95th) for token flush events.
- Concurrency mix note: the long requests (>512 tokens) are mostly background batch jobs and can be rate-limited to off-peak windows.
- Throughput: the 2,500 burst requirement will be needed during weekly catalog refreshes (Tues 03:00 UTC).

We attached a short CSV with recent traffic sampling (token counts + timestamps). Can you confirm the streaming test harness will simulate partial-turn sends and interleaved short/long flows?

Also, Marcus asked whether Redwood's harness will measure KV cache warmup and report per-step token latency (not just response time). If we can capture that, it will be very helpful for our ops team.

Best,
Sophie
Senior Platform PM | BlueWave Retail
[Attachment: bw-sample-traffic-202705.csv (CSV)]

From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.example.com>
To: Sophie Lee <sophie@bluewave-retail.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.example.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.example.com>
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Passband concurrency plan and reproducibility checklist

Appreciate the details, Sophie — that's exactly the kind of info we need. Quick answers and attached artifacts: 

- Harness capability: yes, our harness simulates streaming by sending chunked deltas and measuring per-chunk (per-token) ack times. It can replay interleaved traffic patterns (we'll seed with your CSV).
- KV cache warmup: we will capture per-token generation latency, KV hit/miss counters, and a warmup curve for the first N requests. We'll include those outputs in the run artifacts.

I've attached: bw-prompt-set-v1.jsonl (draft of representative prompts covering short/medium/long examples) and measurement-defs-v1.md (defines 50th/95th/99th per-chunk, warmup definition, and reproducibility criteria). Please treat v1 as a starting point — Marissa, can you validate the measurement bucket definitions are compatible with our harness export format?

Proposed window: Thu 20 May 2027 10:00–12:00 PDT (will run through ramp, steady-state, and burst phases). Sophie, if that works for you we'll lock it and send a runbook + access to the Drive folder.

Thanks,
Logan
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: bw-prompt-set-v1.jsonl (JSONL), measurement-defs-v1.md (MD)]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.example.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.example.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.example.com>
Cc: Sophie Lee <sophie@bluewave-retail.com>, Marcus Chen <marcus.chen@bluewave-retail.com>
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Passband concurrency plan and reproducibility checklist

Looping in Karthik to validate measurement-defs-v1.md and confirm the harness export schema. High-level comments: 

- Measurement buckets look good but need an explicit definition for "steady-state" (I propose 15-min warmup, 30-min steady-state window).
- Add a reproducibility flag: a run is reproducible if median absolute deviation (MAD) across three runs for 95th latency is < 8%.
- For KV warmup, we'll add a per-slot histogram (bucketized by request position within cache lifetime). That will help Marcus correlate cold-starts to downstream tail events.

I'll patch the measurement doc with these edits and upload measurement-defs-v1.1.md to the Drive folder. Sophie — once we finalize, we'll send a short pre-run checklist (network, credentials, dataset seed) and a runbook that includes a shell script to kick off the harness.

Marissa
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: measurement-defs-v1.1.md (MD)]
